calc-extrema-06: 'Local maximum **value**' poochha hai — location $x$ nahi, $f$ ki value chahiye. Pehle critical points nikalo.
$f'(x)=6x^2-6x-12=6(x-2)(x+1)$, to critical points $x=-1$ aur $x=2$. Classify karne ke liye $f''(x)=12x-6$.
$f''(-1)=-18<0$, to $x=-1$ pe max hai. Ab $f(-1)$ calculate karo. Trap: sirf $x=-1$ likh dena, ya $f(2)$ le lena (wo min hai).
calc-extrema-07: Domain sirf $x>0$ hai — jo critical point domain ke bahar ho use ignore karo. Value poochhi hai, location nahi.
$f'=0$ se $x^2=4$, $x=\pm2$; domain me sirf $x=2$ bachta hai. Ab $f(2)$ nikalo. Trap: $x=2$ ko hi answer maan lena.
calc-extrema-08: Closed interval $[0,5]$ hai: absolute max/min ke liye endpoints bhi candidates hain. Har option alag se check karo.
$f'(x)=3(x-1)(x-3)$, $f''(x)=6x-12$. Candidates: $x=0,1,3,5$. Inflection wahan hota hai jahan $f''$ ka sign badle.
$f(1)=5$ aur $f(0)=1$. Ab $f(3)$ aur $f(5)$ nikalo aur charon compare karo. Trap: endpoint $x=5$ bhool jaana.
calc-extrema-09: Closed interval $[-1,3]$: interval ke andar wale critical points aur dono endpoints — sab candidates hain.
$f'(x)=4x(x-2)(x+2)$. $x=-2$ interval ke bahar hai, to candidates $x=-1,0,2,3$.
$f(-1)=-2$, $f(0)=5$, $f(2)=-11$. Ab $f(3)$ nikalo aur compare karo. Trap: sirf critical points dekh kar ruk jaana.
calc-extrema-10: $x^{2/3}$ wala function hai — $x=0$ pe $f'$ exist nahi karta. Critical points me $f'$-undefined wale points bhi aate hain.
Sign check: $x=-1$ pe $f'=\frac{5(-3)}{3(-1)}=5>0$. Ab $(0,2)$ aur $x>2$ me sign dekho. Trap: $x=0$ ko critical point na maanna.
calc-convexity-05: Convexity ka test second derivative se hota hai — $f'$ se nahi. Dekho $f''$ kahan non-negative hai.
Inequality $6x-6\ge0$ solve karo. Trap: inequality ulti lena — $f''\le0$ concave region deta hai.
calc-convexity-06: Concave matlab $f''\le0$. Interval $[p,q]$ ke endpoints $f''$ ke roots honge.
$x^2-3x+2$ factor karo aur dekho kin do roots ke beech ye negative hai. Trap: $f'=0$ solve kar dena.
calc-convexity-07: Interval $(0,\infty)$ hai, poora $\mathbb R$ nahi. Har function ka $f''$ sirf $x>0$ pe check karo.
Convex $\iff f''(x)\ge0$ har $x>0$ pe. Example: $(-\ln x)'=-1/x$, to $(-\ln x)''=1/x^2$.
$(x^2-x^3)''=2-6x$, jo $x=1$ pe $-4$ hai. Ab $\sqrt x$ aur $1/x$ ka $f''$ khud nikalo. Trap: sign galat padhna.
calc-convexity-08: $f''$ factored form me diya hai. Convex = $f''\ge0$; inflection = jahan $f''$ ka **sign badle** — sirf zero hona kaafi nahi.
$(x-1)^2$ hamesha $\ge0$ hai, isliye $f''$ ka sign $(x-4)$ ke sign jaisa hai (bas $x=1$ pe zero).
$f''(0)=-4$ aur $f''(2)=-2$. To kya $x=1$ pe sign badla? Ab $x>4$ check karo. Trap: har zero ko inflection maan lena.
calc-convexity-09: 'Convex on all of $\mathbb R$' ka matlab $f''(x)\ge0$ har $x$ pe — to $f''$ ka **minimum** dekhna hai.
Sabse chhota $f''$ hai $f''(0)=1+1+2a$. Ise $\ge0$ rakh kar $a$ ke liye solve karo. Trap: $(ax^2)''=a$ likh dena — wo $2a$ hai.
calc-convexity-10: Convex + differentiable: graph hamesha apni tangent line ke **upar** rehta hai. $x=1$ pe tangent socho.
Tangent at $1$: $y=3+2(x-1)$. Convexity se $f(x)\ge3+2(x-1)$ har $x$ ke liye.
$x=3$ daalo: bound $3+2\cdot2$. Ab $x=0$ khud karo. D ke liye socho: kya koi linear function ye data satisfy karta hai? Trap: inequality ulti lena.
calc-opt-word-05: Constraint $xy=64$ se ek variable hatao, phir objective $x+4y$ ko ek hi variable me likho. Value poochhi hai.
$S'=0$ se $x^2=256$, $x=16$, aur $y=64/16=4$. Ab $S$ nikalo. Trap: symmetry se $x=y=8$ le lena.
calc-opt-word-06: Volume fixed hai, surface area minimise karna hai. Volume se $h$ ko $r$ me likho; dono ends (top + bottom) gino.
$S'(r)=4\pi r-\dfrac{256\pi}{r^2}=0$ se $r^3=64$, $r=4$, $h=8$. Ab $S$ nikalo aur $\pi$ se divide karo. Trap: ek hi end ginna.
calc-opt-word-07: Line ka har point $(x,2x)$ hai. Distance ka square minimise karna aasaan hai — last me square root lena mat bhoolna.
$D'=0$ se $10x=10$, $x=1$, point $(1,2)$. Ab $D(1)$ nikalo aur uska root lo. Trap: $D$ ko hi distance bol dena.
calc-opt-word-08: Closed interval $[0,20]$ aur **maximum** chahiye. Critical point minimum bhi ho sakta hai — endpoints zaroor check karo.
Square ki side $x/4$, circle ka radius $\frac{20-x}{2\pi}$: $A(x)=\dfrac{x^2}{16}+\dfrac{(20-x)^2}{4\pi}$.
$A'(x)=0$ se $x=\dfrac{80}{\pi+4}$, par wahan $A''>0$ — to ye max hai ya min? Ab $A(0)$ aur $A(20)$ compare karo. Trap: critical point ko hi answer maan lena.
calc-opt-word-09: Wall wali side pe fence nahi lagegi — sirf teen sides. Area fixed hai, fence ki length minimise karni hai.
Wall ke perpendicular do sides $x$, parallel side $y$: $xy=50$, fence $F(x)=2x+\dfrac{50}{x}$.
$F'(x)=2-\dfrac{50}{x^2}=0$ se $x^2=25$, $x=5$, aur $y=10$. Ab $F$ nikalo. Trap: chaaron sides fence karna ya square maan lena.
calc-opt-word-10: Volume fixed hai, material minimise karna hai. $h$ ko $x$ me likh kar $S$ ko ek variable ka function banao. Har option alag check karo.
$S'(x)=2x-\dfrac{128}{x^2}=0$ se $x^3=64$. Ab $x$, $h$, $S$ nikalo aur $S''$ ka sign dekho. Trap: closed box wala cube result yahan lagana.
calc-gradient-descent-06: Ek step ka update chahiye. $x_0=2$ pe gradient (derivative) chahiye — function ki value nahi.
$f'(2)=4\cdot2^3-4\cdot2$ calculate karo, phir $0.05$ se multiply karke 2 me se **ghatao**. Trap: $-4x$ wala term chhodna ya step add kar dena.
calc-gradient-descent-07: Do variables hain — har coordinate ka apna partial derivative, aur dono ko ek saath update karna hai.
$\partial f/\partial x=2(x-1)$, $\partial f/\partial y=2\cdot2(y+1)=4(y+1)$. Update: $(x,y)-0.25\,\nabla f$.
$(0,0)$ pe $\partial f/\partial x=-2$. $\partial f/\partial y$ khud nikalo, phir $0.25$ guna gradient **ghatao**. Trap: gradient add kar dena.
calc-gradient-descent-08: $f$ quadratic hai, to har GD step $x$ ko ek constant factor se multiply karta hai. Pehle wo factor nikalo.
$|1-6\eta|<1$ ka matlab $-1<1-6\eta<1$. Dono inequalities alag se solve karo. Trap: sirf $1-6\eta>0$ (no oscillation) le lena.
calc-gradient-descent-09: Har option me alag $\eta$ hai. Ek general formula banao jo bataye ki har step me $x_k-2$ kitna scale hota hai.
$f'(x)=2(x-2)$, isliye $x_{k+1}-2=(1-2\eta)(x_k-2)$. Factor ka absolute value $<1$ ho to convergence.
Pehla option: $f'(0)=-4$, to $x_1=0-0.5\cdot(-4)$. Baaki options ke liye factor $1-2\eta$ har $\eta$ pe nikalo. Trap: overshoot ko divergence samajhna.
calc-gradient-descent-10: Loss do samples ka average hai. Gradient me dono samples ka hissa jodo — chain rule se har term me factor $x_i$ aata hai.
$w=1$ pe sample 1 ka term: $(1\cdot1-2)\cdot1=-1$. Sample 2 ka term khud nikalo, jodo, phir update karo. Trap: factor $x_i$ ya 2 bhool jaana.
